metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins: BDD/SAFe ticket shaping, Gherkin acceptance criteria, and test scaffolding from those criteria. Tracker-agnostic and test-framework-agnostic — site specifics come from a config file in the consuming repo.

plugins.name: bdd-delivery
plugins.description: Write tickets in SAFe/BDD shape with Gherkin acceptance criteria, then turn those scenarios into tests. Ships Jira and GitHub Issues tracker adapters; the ticket rules themselves know nothing about either.
